svg.text: What each branch sees around one second t (offline, non-causal; times in seconds)
time since recording start (s), illustrative recording
curve: blending weight w(τ) = 0.05 + sin²(π(τ + 0.5)/L), τ = second within the window, L = 240
p_L(t): weighted mean over the windows covering t (here [120, 360) and [240, 480));
inside a window each second sees the whole window, past and future (BiLinOSS)
±7-window context of the window starting at 300 s: starts 195-405 (±105 s), signal [195, 465) = 270 s
each clip is scored from its own 12 s; the split is random within patient (70 / 15 / 15),
so the neighbours of a test clip are mostly train or dev clips: no statistic may cross a clip boundary
